entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • IDE0047 suggests removing parentheses that are required for compilation #80938
  • Breaking change from `9.0.102` to `>=9.0.200` #80937
  • Feature Request: folding multiline method signatures #80946
    Backlog

Closed

  • It looks like MethodCompiler.BindMethodBody reports some errors that actually belong in declaration phase #25658
    Backlog
  • Name of ```AllowedRequiredModifierType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_OutAttribute``` implies wrong location of the ```OutAttribute``` type #74403
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11127.172 #80935
  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Features 5.0.0-2.final missing from NuGet.org #80915
  • Second half of `bindInvocationExpressionContinued` local function appears unreachable #78954
    18.3
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-11127.165 #80926

PullRequests

Created

  • fix: Add check before show signature help #80945
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Add ParameterListStructureProvider for collapsing multi-line parameter lists #80944
    VSCode
  • Add documentation for Sequence Points design #80943
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Cleanup usage of BoundBinaryOperator.Method API #80942
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.0] Get solution explorer symbol view working on .Net Fx projects #80941
  • Add support for HandleAsyncEntryPoint API in async Main code generation #80939
  • Decouple synthesized top-level types tracking from PrivateImplementationDetails #80936
    Area-Compilers
  • Add detection for async-iterators with runtime-async #80934
  • Add regression tests for nullable analysis assert with collection expressions and params Add methods #80933
  • Fix nullability assertion failure with extension Add methods in collection expressions #80932
  • Remove some unused AbstractFlowPass parameters #80931
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix null reference crash in CheckUnderspecifiedGenericExtension for namespace-level extensions #80929
  • Extensions: improve diagnostics for operators #80928
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix bad jump from yield break inside catch in async-iterator #80927
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Async Streams

Merged

  • Pass the correct item ID when checking the type of an item #80940
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Rename GetIsNewExtensionMember helpers #80925
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Rename `AllowedRequiredModifierType.System_Runtime_CompilerServices_OutAttribute` to reflect actual type namespace. #80924
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix issue with when a CR/LF split occurs at a SubText's underlying span start #80911
    Area-Compilers
  • Implement canonical miscellaneous files project loader for non-file-based programs #80748
    VSCode
  • Enable runtime async tests #80362
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Avoid deep recursion for nested bound patterns #80920
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Pattern Matching
  • Mention conditionals in CFG section in Compiler Test Plan #80855
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Fix parsing of delegate declarations with tuple return types at top-level #80889
    Area-Compilers
  • File-based programs live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode
